devdoc.author: Ethichub
devdoc.details: This contract manages credit lines, allowing for the creation, modification, and interaction with credit facilities. It handles borrowing, repayment, fee management, and various administrative functions.

AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

ERC1967InvalidImplementation(address).details: The `implementation` of the proxy is invalid.

ERC1967NonPayable().details: An upgrade function sees `msg.value > 0` that may be lost.

ERC721IncorrectOwner(address,uint256,add.details: Indicates an error related to the ownership over a particular token. Used in transfers.

params.owner: Address of the current owner of a token.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC721InsufficientApproval(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `operator`’s approval. Used in transfers.

params.operator: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC721InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC721InvalidOperator(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `operator` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.operator: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC721InvalidOwner(address).details: Indicates that an address can't be an owner. For example, `address(0)` is a forbidden owner in ERC-20. Used in balance queries.

params.owner: Address of the current owner of a token.

ERC721InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC721InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC721NonexistentToken(uint256).details: Indicates a `tokenId` whose `owner` is the zero address.

ERC721OutOfBoundsIndex(address,uint256).details: An `owner`'s token query was out of bounds for `index`. NOTE: The owner being `address(0)` indicates a global out of bounds index.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

FailedCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

TransferDisabled().details: Error thrown when attempting to transfer a credit line NFT.

UUPSUnauthorizedCallContext().details: The call is from an unauthorized context.

UUPSUnsupportedProxiableUUID(bytes32).details: The storage `slot` is unsupported as a UUID.

ZeroAddress().details: Error thrown when an operation involves the zero address

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `owner` enables `approved` to manage the `tokenId` token.

ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool).details: Emitted when `owner` enables or disables (`approved`) `operator` to manage all of its assets.

CreditLineMinted(uint256).details: Emitted when a new credit line NFT is created.

params.id: The unique identifier of the created credit line NFT.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

TokensSwept(address,uint256).details: Emitted when tokens are swept from the contract

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `tokenId` token is transferred from `from` to `to`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

params._accessManager: The address of the access management contract.
params._name: The name of the NFT token.
params._symbol: The symbol of the NFT token.

auditorOpenCredit(address).details: This function is useful for tracking an auditor's outstanding credit

params.auditor: The address of the credit auditor

returns._0: The total amount of open credit for the specified auditor

borrow(uint256,uint256).details: Allows borrowing from a credit line.

burn(uint256).details: Burns `tokenId`. See {ERC721-_burn}. Requirements: - The caller must own `tokenId` or be an approved operator.

claimAuditorFees(uint256).details: Claims auditor fees for a credit line.

claimCollateralFees(uint256).details: Claims collateral fees for a credit line.

claimPlatformFees(uint256).details: Claims platform fees for a credit line.

creditLines(uint256).details: This function returns the entire CreditLine struct, including all associated data

params.creditLineID: The unique identifier of the credit line (ERC721 token ID)

returns._0: A CreditLineLib.CreditLine struct containing all credit line information

credits(uint256).details: This function returns an array of all credits, including historical ones

params.creditLineID: The unique identifier of the credit line (ERC721 token ID)

returns._0: An array of CreditLib.Credit structs representing all credits in the credit line

currentCredit(uint256).details: This function returns the most recent credit in the credit line

params.creditLineID: The unique identifier of the credit line (ERC721 token ID)

returns._0: A CreditLib.Credit struct representing the current credit

expandCreditInCreditLine(uint256,uint256.details: Expand the current credit from a credit line.

getNonAccruedInterest(uint256).details: This function retrieves the current credit state and calculates the interest      that has not yet been accrued

params.creditLineID: The unique identifier of the credit line (ERC721 token ID)

returns._0: The amount of non-accrued interest as a uint256

getUnclaimedProtocolFees().details: Retrieves the total unclaimed protocol fees.

params._accessManager: Address of the access manager contract
params._liquidityReserve: Address of the liquidity reserve used for transactions
params._name: Name of the credit line token
params._symbol: Symbol of the credit line token

liquidityReserve().details: The liquidity reserve is the main currency used for borrowing and repayment

returns._0: The address of the liquidity reserve contract

openCreditInCreditLine(uint256,uint256,u.details: Opens a new credit in an existing credit line.

params.maturity: Duration of the credit in seconds

openCreditLine(address,address).details: Opens a new credit line and mints an NFT representing it. Can only be called by an account with the AUDITOR role and when the contract is not paused.

returns.creditLineID: The ID of the newly created credit line

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

removeCurrentCredit(uint256).details: Removes the current credit from a credit line.

renewCreditInCreditLine(uint256,uint256,.details: Renews an existing credit in a credit line.

repay(uint256,uint256).details: Allows repayment to a credit line.

sweepTokens(address,address).details: This function can only be called by an account with the TREASURY_MANAGER roleWARNING: Due diligence is needed on the token address, as it might be malicious

params.to: Address to send the swept tokens to
params.token: Address of the token to sweep

updateCreditLineFees(uint256,uint256,uin.details: Updates the fees for a credit line.

updateCreditLinePrincipalToken(uint256,a.details: Updates principal token for a credit line.

updateCreditLineReserves(uint256,address.details: Updates the reserve addresses for a credit line.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.
